newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sophia in convertible bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Sophia in convertible bond issue.

text.p: French property financing specialist Sophia is launching a 3.75 percent 2004 convertible bond at a nominal unit price of 270 francs to raise 791.1 million francs, lead manager Cie Parisienne de Reescompte (CPR) announced on Tuesday.
The amount of the borrowing could be increased to 916.6 million francs, CPR said in a statement.
Shareholders can have priority rights to subscribe to the offer, which runs from April 9 to April 22 on the basis of one bond for every five shares held.
The bonds will be convertible anytime from January 1, 1998 on the basis of one share for one convertible bond.
Sophia shares closed on Tuesday at 239 francs, down 0.21 percent.

"As a result of this operation, the Sophia group is taking the opportunity to strengthen its financial means with a view to develop its financing and investment activities," said company chairman Jean-Claude Wagner in a separate statement.
